bio.text: James Byrd is the Democratic candidate for U.S. Senate from Wyoming in 2026.
In his WyoFile election guide response, Byrd describes himself as a fifth-generation Wyomingite who lives in Cheyenne.
He says he served in the Wyoming House of Representatives for District 44 from 2009 to 2019 and was the Democratic nominee for Secretary of State in 2018.
He also says he worked as an exploration geophysicist in Colorado and later as an IT project manager and software consultant.
